observations: At two kilograms, ten square centimetres gave 19,620 Pa; thirty square centimetres gave 6,540 Pa.
Doubling mass to four kilograms at the wide footprint doubled pressure to 13,080 Pa.
Screenshot showed a wider contact rectangle with the same downward mass arrow.
Reveal distinguishes lower average pressure from unchanged total weight and explicitly excludes safe load and local material stress.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish weight from average contact pressure.

whyCool: Spreading a load lowers average pressure while leaving the total weight unchanged.
caveat: Average-pressure illustration, not a furniture strength assessment.
effort: Prediction, both footprints, doubled mass, screenshots and reveal.
